tasks.short: Draft electrical detail and assembly drawings

steps.what: Resolve design components and circuitry, arranging the drawing geometry and connection details
Produce repeated detail and assembly drawing views, labels and tables from the checked model
Check drawing geometry, circuitry and assembly meaning before submitting the draft for engineering review

tasks.design: Configure repeated views, labels and tables in the electrical design application in {OTHER}. The drafter constructs the model and checks every generated sheet's technical meaning before engineering review; no automatic component selection or circuit design is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated sheet detailing can be disconnected from the underlying model.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing templates can reuse explicit model objects and properties.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting design intent and ensuring the assembly drawing represents the actual connections.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter recognises ambiguous geometry and misleading but syntactically valid connections.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated sheet production; drafting and engineering decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Provide a traceable drawing draft for technical review
reach.learn: Model properties, design intent and review boundaries

evidence.claim: Eplan Electric P8 generates reports, wire lists and bills of materials; this supports structured electrical model outputs, not autonomous drawing design.
Model knowledge: configuring repeated drawing views and annotations may reduce manual drafting; the proposed share and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers drafting individual detail and assembly drawings, excluding drawing-package assembly and independent engineering approval.

OTHER means the electrical design application. In s1 the drafter produces object identifiers, component references, geometry, connection endpoints, view choices, dimensions, units and revision. Selecting and capturing these fields remains in s1 at full time.

The drafting standards owner supplies the sheet template and property mapping; added upkeep is charged to other_role. Missing properties or unsupported views use manual drafting and checking in s3, without inventing connections.
Test native generation first. The machine renders chosen content only; existing automatic rendering runtime earns no labour saving.
unknowns: Which sheet details are still repeated manually
Whether the present application supports the needed model properties
research_questions: Can repeated sheets be generated without increasing connectivity or assembly-interpretation defects?

already_counted.description: Construct model content and check generated drawing meaning

incremental.description: Resolve generation exceptions and check template changes
Maintain drawing templates and property mappings

approvals.approved_version: Exact sheet revision, model snapshot and connection details checked before draft submission; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gives gross25, less focal upkeep8 gives net17. Range0-4 assumes native tools already render most sheets and only a minority of repeated annotations remain manual; design and checking retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draft installation working drawings and wiring instructions

steps.what: Translate the required wiring and cable installation details into a checked drawing specification
Render working drawings and wiring connection schedules from selected model views and fields
Verify that drawings and connection instructions communicate the intended installation, then submit for review

tasks.design: Use native installation sheet and connection-table configuration in the electrical design application in {OTHER}, with reference documents in {DOCS}. The drafter specifies the installation content and checks clarity, connections and cross-sections; the design does not automatically authorise construction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated connection and sheet details can require manual reproduction.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured views and connection tables can render the drafter's explicit model choices.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving site ambiguities and making instructions understandable to the installation crew.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter notices when the drawing could lead an installer to the wrong interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated rendering; no change to engineering approval or installation authority.

reach.task: Explain drawing references and unresolved installation questions

evidence.claim: Eplan Electric P8 supports wire lists and reports from electrical design data; it does not establish site installation intent.
Model knowledge: native view and connection-table configuration can remove repeated rendering after the drafter specifies the installation model.

assumptions: Boundary covers working drawings and connection instructions, excluding component assembly drawings, package collation and construction release. If the same sheet serves two tasks, a roll-up must assign its production once.

OTHER means the electrical design application. The drafter produces cable IDs, endpoints, conductor references, route geometry, cross-section choices, dimensions, units, drawing views and revision in s1. All interpretation, field capture and corrections retain s1's time.

The standards owner produces the template and permitted field mappings; added upkeep is charged below. Missing route or endpoint evidence stops rendering of that item and returns to manual drafting in s3.
Test native configuration first. Only previously manual rendering loses time; existing model runtime and all technical checks are excluded from savings.
unknowns: The split between manual sheet detailing and existing native output
research_questions: Do configured installation sheets reduce repeated work while preserving correct endpoint and cross-section interpretation?

already_counted.description: Specify installation content and verify the resulting instructions

incremental.description: Handle unsupported view and mapping cases

approvals.approved_version: Exact installation sheet revision, model snapshot, connection schedule and reference drawings; any edit requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gives gross20, less focal upkeep7 gives net13. Range0-3 assumes substantial native rendering already exists and only a few recurring manual details change; interpretation and verification remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assemble documentation packages and drawing sets for checking

steps.what: Select documentation and drawing revisions required for the engineer's checking package
Assemble the selected drawing files and documentation into an indexed review package
Check the assembled drawing set and documentation for completeness before sending it for review

tasks.design: Configure collection and index generation in {DOCS} from an explicit, checked package manifest. The drafter checks included revisions, readable sheets and missing context before submitting to the engineer or architect, whose technical review remains separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected files and sheet indexes may be assembled repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document collections can package exact versions without choosing their technical suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which documents belong together and detecting omitted design context.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter understands whether the collection gives the reviewer enough information.
tasks.altitude: Less file collation; no transfer of engineering checking authority.

reach.learn: Version manifests and review status conventions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document collections and index generation can assemble an explicit list of file versions; the digest does not measure review-package assembly.

assumptions: Boundary is package selection, collation and submission. Creation of the drawings and the engineer's technical review are excluded, so their savings are not counted again.

In s1 the drafter produces document ID, exact revision, location, sheet order, review status, required attachments and intended reviewer. Manifest capture and resolving missing versions remain fully counted.

The document standards owner supplies package layout and required metadata; added maintenance is charged to other_role. Missing or inaccessible versions stop automatic assembly and use manual collection and checking in s3.
Test native collections and index export first. The machine follows the manifest and cannot mark drawings technically approved; existing file export runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether packages are already generated natively
Which attachments require judgement to identify
research_questions: Can manifest-based packaging remove manual collation without wrong revisions or missing technical context?

already_counted.description: Choose exact versions and inspect and submit the package

incremental.description: Resolve failed collections and check package setup changes
Maintain package layout and metadata rules

approvals.approved_version: Exact package snapshot, ordered file revisions, index, attachments and intended reviewer; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R55 gives gross45, less focal upkeep7 gives net38. Range0-7 assumes many packages already export natively and remaining cases need substantial manual selection and checking; engineering review time is untouched.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review construction drawings and estimates for accuracy and conformity

steps.what: Review construction drawings and cost estimates against design intent, applicable standards and regulations

tasks.design: Retain the drafter's substantive review using the controlled references in {DOCS}. The output is a set of findings and unresolved questions for the responsible engineer, rather than a software declaration of regulatory conformity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Correctness depends on design context and applicability of requirements, not just matching values.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied digest demonstrates checks in other model contexts but does not establish complete electrical drawing or cost-estimate review.
tasks.still_hard: Identifying omitted requirements and judging whether a technically plausible detail is appropriate.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can connect inconsistencies across drawings, estimates and the actual design intent.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in review responsibility or authority to certify conformity.

reach.task: Explain drawing and estimate review findings
reach.learn: Requirement applicability and evidence for technical concerns

evidence.claim: Solibri Advanced supports custom regulatory checks, clashes and IDS validation on IFC models; that capability does not establish complete electrical drawing and estimate review.
Model knowledge: substantive review of design accuracy and requirement applicability remains human in this proposal.

assumptions: Boundary is the drafter's review and findings, excluding drawing production and any independent certification or engineer's final acceptance.

The drafter identifies document revisions, applicable requirement clauses, estimate assumptions and suspected discrepancies during s1. Capture and checking are part of its full time; there is no free structured compliance or discrepancy code.
Unclear applicability or incomplete design evidence is raised with the responsible engineer rather than converted into an automatic pass.
Use existing controlled documents and native review tools. No new rules engine or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which checks are routine and explicitly codifiable
Who decides applicability and final acceptance
research_questions: Can a timed review sample isolate repeatable arithmetic or identifier checks without reducing substantive review time?

already_counted.description: Review accuracy, applicability and conformity and record findings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. Both straightforward consistency review and disputed requirement applicability retain full review time.

role.altitude: Automate explicit sheet rendering and package collation while keeping design interpretation and substantive review fully counted.
reach: Prepare version-controlled review packages for document control
Explain drawing assumptions and findings to engineers and installers
role.ambitious_version: An electrical drafter who can reproduce exact review packages quickly and spends the retained time on unambiguous, technically sound drawings.
